_doc: Sea-access corridors drawn as arcs from Addis Ababa to each port. Status, summary and sources are taken from the linked infrastructure records (data/curated/infrastructure.geojson) so they cannot drift. Arcs show the corridor, not trade volume. Port Sudan is not included because no sourced status has been recorded for it yet.

corridors.name: Djibouti corridor
corridors.summary: 752 km electrified standard-gauge line operated by Ethio-Djibouti Railway (EDR). Commercial service since 2018. EDR plans to raise freight capacity from 2 Mt to 6.2 Mt a year by 2027 and to link more Djibouti terminals by end-2026. Main truck route for Ethiopia's imports via Djibouti. A 2026 fuel shortage slowed trucking on this corridor and shifted some cargo to rail.

corridors.name: Berbera corridor
corridors.summary: Road from the Ethiopian border to Berbera port, launched 2019. An undated report gives 85% complete; no 2026 status found.

corridors.name: LAPSSET / Lamu corridor
corridors.summary: Lamu port declared operational Feb 2026. Isiolo–Moyale–Hawassa road reported complete; Lamu–Garissa–Isiolo road partly built. Lamu–Ethiopia railway at planning stage.
